## About Alan Barben & American Legacy Contracting

Alan Barben is the owner and sole operator of American Legacy Contracting, based in Payson, Utah. Unlike larger contractors, Alan personally manages and works on every project — there are no sales reps, no project managers, no middlemen. Homeowners work directly with Alan from the initial estimate through the final walkthrough.

**Qualifications:**
- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management
- Applied Science degree in Construction Management
- 14+ years of experience in residential and commercial construction
- Hands-on expertise across framing, electrical, HVAC, and plumbing
- Fully licensed and insured in the state of Utah
- BuildZoom ranks American Legacy Contracting in the top 1% of general contractors in Utah (above 74,376 other contractors)
- Maintains a network of trusted, licensed electricians and plumbers for specialized work

**Contact:**

## Services

### Basement Finishing
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/basement-finishing/

Turning unfinished basements into livable square footage. Alan personally manages every basement project from design through final walkthrough.

**What we build:** Family and entertainment rooms, extra bedrooms (with egress windows), home offices, bathrooms, home theaters, kids' playrooms, home gyms, mother-in-law suites, wet bars, craft rooms, and game rooms.

**Our process:**
1. Consultation & design — discuss layout, functionality, and budget
2. Permits & planning — pull required building permits
3. Framing & electrical — build walls, run wiring, rough-in plumbing
4. Drywall & finishing — hang drywall, paint, install flooring and fixtures
5. Final walkthrough — inspect everything together before signing off

**Frequently asked questions:**

Q: How much does it cost to finish a basement in Utah?
A: Most basement finishes run $25 to $50 per square foot, depending on complexity. A basic finish for a 1,000 sq ft basement might start around $25,000, while a high-end finish with a bathroom, wet bar, or theater could reach $50,000 or more. We provide free, detailed estimates for every project.

Q: How long does a basement finish take?
A: Most basement finishing projects take 4 to 8 weeks, depending on size and complexity. Larger projects with bathrooms or custom features may take longer. We'll give you a realistic timeline before we start.

Q: Do I need a permit to finish my basement?
A: Yes. Any basement finish in Utah that involves framing, electrical, plumbing, or HVAC requires a building permit. We handle the entire permit process for you, including scheduling inspections.

Q: What's the ROI on finishing a basement?
A: Basement finishing typically returns about 70% of your investment in added home value, making it one of the best home improvement ROI projects. Beyond resale value, you gain usable living space immediately.

### Kitchen & Bathroom Remodels
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/kitchen-bathroom-remodels/

Full kitchen and bathroom renovations throughout Utah County.

**Kitchen remodeling includes:** Custom and semi-custom cabinets, countertop installation (granite, quartz, butcher block), flooring (tile, hardwood, LVP), lighting upgrades and recessed lighting, layout changes and wall removal, appliance installation, backsplash tile work.

**Bathroom remodeling includes:** Tile work (floor, shower, backsplash), vanities and storage solutions, shower and tub installation or conversion, flooring replacement, fixtures and hardware upgrades, accessibility upgrades (grab bars, walk-in showers).

**Our approach:**
1. Consultation — discuss vision, needs, and budget
2. Design & material selection — choose finishes and fixtures together
3. Demolition — remove old fixtures, flooring, and finishes
4. Build & install — framing, plumbing, electrical, tile, cabinetry
5. Finishing touches — paint, hardware, fixtures, final cleanup

**Frequently asked questions:**

Q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost?
A: Kitchen remodel costs vary widely. A minor refresh (new countertops, paint, hardware) might run $10,000-$25,000. A mid-range remodel with new cabinets and layout updates runs $25,000-$50,000. Major renovations with structural changes can exceed $50,000-$100,000. Cabinets typically account for 30-40% of the budget.

Q: How long does a bathroom remodel take?
A: A half-bath remodel takes 1-2 weeks, a full bathroom 2-4 weeks, and a master bathroom 4-6 weeks. Timelines depend on scope, material lead times, and whether structural or plumbing changes are needed.

Q: Can you work with my existing layout?
A: Absolutely. Not every remodel needs structural changes. We can refresh your space with new finishes, fixtures, and cosmetic updates while keeping the existing layout.

Q: Do you handle plumbing and electrical?
A: Yes. Alan handles general construction directly and coordinates licensed, insured plumbers and electricians for specialized work. You deal with one point of contact for the entire project.

### New Construction
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/new-construction/

Custom home building, spec homes, home additions, and ADUs across Utah County.

**What we build:** Custom homes built to your specifications, spec homes, room additions and home additions, ADUs (accessory dwelling units), and mother-in-law suites.

**Building process:**
1. Land consultation — evaluate your lot, soil conditions, and local building codes
2. Design & architecture — work with architects to finalize plans
3. Permits — submit plans and pull all required permits
4. Foundation & framing — pour foundation, frame structure
5. Systems — electrical, plumbing, HVAC rough-in and finish
6. Finishing — drywall, paint, flooring, cabinets, fixtures, landscaping
7. Final inspection & walkthrough — city inspection and walk-through together

**Frequently asked questions:**

Q: How much does it cost to build a custom home?
A: Custom home costs vary significantly based on size, finishes, lot conditions, and complexity. We provide detailed estimates after reviewing your plans and lot.

Q: How long does new construction take?
A: A typical custom home takes 6-12 months from groundbreaking to move-in. Home additions usually take 2-4 months. Timelines depend on scope, weather, and permitting.

Q: Do you build home additions and ADUs?
A: Yes. Room additions, second-story additions, and accessory dwelling units (ADUs/mother-in-law suites) are all services we offer. These are popular for growing families or rental income.

Q: Who handles permits and inspections?
A: We manage the entire permit and inspection process, from initial submittal through final certificate of occupancy.

### Handyman Services
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/services/handyman-services/

Licensed contractor-quality handyman services. Unlike typical handymen, Alan is a fully licensed general contractor with formal construction management training.

**Services offered:** Drywall repair and installation, door installation and repair, fence repair and installation, deck repair and maintenance, tile repair, shelving and storage solutions, painting and touch-ups, general home repairs, flooring installation and repair, trim and molding.

**Trusted network:** For electrical and plumbing work, Alan coordinates licensed, insured specialists. You get one point of contact — Alan manages everything.

**Why a licensed contractor matters for handyman work:** Better quality from formal training, proper insurance coverage, and the ability to pull permits if a small job turns out to need one.

**Frequently asked questions:**

Q: What do you charge for handyman work?
A: We provide upfront pricing before starting any work. No surprise charges.

Q: Can you handle electrical or plumbing?
A: We coordinate with licensed electricians and plumbers from our trusted network. Alan manages the project so you only deal with one person.

Q: Is there a minimum job size?
A: No. We handle everything from small repairs to larger projects. No job is too small.

Q: How quickly can you start?
A: Most handyman projects can start within a week of your initial call.

## Blog — Guides for Utah Homeowners

### How Much Does It Cost to Finish a Basement in Utah? (2026 Guide)
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/basement-finishing-cost-utah/

Basement finishing costs in Utah typically range from $25 to $50 per square foot, or $15,000 to $50,000+ depending on size and finishes. Basic finishes (framing, drywall, carpet, paint) run $25-30/sq ft. Mid-range finishes (LVP flooring, simple bathroom, recessed lighting) run $30-40/sq ft. High-end finishes (custom bathroom, wet bar, theater, heated floors) run $40-50+/sq ft. Key cost factors include total square footage, number of bathrooms, egress windows, finish quality, permits, and HVAC extension. Basement finishing typically returns about 70% of investment in added home value.

### 10 Basement Finishing Ideas Perfect for Utah Homes
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/basement-finishing-ideas-utah-homes/

Ten popular options for Utah homeowners with rough costs: (1) Family room ($15-30K), (2) Home theater ($20-45K), (3) Extra bedrooms ($8-18K per room), (4) Home office ($8-15K), (5) Home gym ($10-25K), (6) Kids' playroom ($12-22K), (7) Mother-in-law suite ($40-80K+), (8) Craft room ($10-20K), (9) Game room ($15-30K), (10) Wet bar ($8-20K). Utah's cold winters make basements especially valuable as year-round living space.

### Do You Need a Permit to Finish Your Basement in Utah?
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/do-you-need-permit-finish-basement-utah/

Yes, you almost always need a building permit to finish a basement in Utah. Permits are required for framing, electrical, plumbing, egress windows, HVAC, and insulation/drywall. Permits are NOT required for purely cosmetic work like painting, flooring replacement over existing subfloor, or installing shelving. Typical permit costs run $200-500. Consequences of skipping permits include failed inspections at resale, insurance claim denials, safety risks, fines, and appraisal problems. Licensed contractors handle the permit process for homeowners.

### How Long Does a Bathroom Remodel Take? (Realistic Timeline)
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/how-long-does-bathroom-remodel-take/

Most bathroom remodels take 2-4 weeks, but major gut jobs can stretch to 6 weeks or more. Phase breakdown: demolition (1-3 days), plumbing and electrical rough-in (2-4 days), waterproofing (1-2 days), tile installation (3-7 days), fixture installation (1-2 days), finishing touches (1-2 days). Half baths take 1-2 weeks, full bathrooms 2-4 weeks, master bathrooms 4-6 weeks. Common delay causes include material back-orders, hidden water damage, and permit inspection scheduling.

### How Much Does a Kitchen Remodel Cost in Utah? (2026 Guide)
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/kitchen-remodel-cost-utah/

Kitchen remodel costs in Utah range from $10,000 for a minor refresh to $100,000+ for a major renovation. Minor refresh ($10-25K): new countertops, cabinet refacing, paint, hardware. Mid-range ($25-50K): new cabinets, countertops, flooring, lighting, minor layout changes. Major renovation ($50-100K+): structural changes, premium appliances, custom cabinetry, complete redesign. Cabinets consume 30-40% of the typical budget. Timeline ranges from 1 week for cosmetic updates to 8-10 weeks for major renovations.

### How to Choose a General Contractor in Utah: 8 Things to Check
**URL:** https://americanlegacycontracting.com/blog/how-to-choose-general-contractor-utah/

Eight essential verification points: (1) Verify their Utah contractor license, (2) Confirm insurance coverage, (3) Check experience and specialization, (4) Read reviews and ask for references, (5) Get multiple estimates (at least 3), (6) Ask about subcontractors, (7) Require a written contract, (8) Evaluate communication style. Red flags to avoid: no physical address, cash-only requests, no written estimate, door-to-door solicitation, demand for full payment upfront, refusal to provide references.
